parsed.post: Agent-3 R9: DEPTH 6->8 kept on clean 0-9: 1.03247->1.01153 (~0.021), fits 300s at 14.2M params. Final round: WEIGHT_DECAY 0->0.01 at depth 8, since agents 2/7 reported 0.01-0.04 WD gains on clean shards. Holding LR 0.08 to isolate the WD effect; agent-1 covers WD 0.1.
